standing: Balanced, everyday standing poses ideal for portraits and lookbooks.
sitting: Seated poses for chairs, steps, ledges and the floor.
leaning: Relaxed poses leaning against a wall, doorway or railing.
walking: Mid-stride candid walking poses for natural movement.
full_body: Dynamic full-figure poses showing the whole body.
hand_poses: Hand and gesture references for detail shots.
couple_poses: Two-person poses for couples and duo shoots.
outdoor: Open-air poses suited to parks, streets and nature.
creative: Expressive, editorial and artistic pose ideas.
